item.title: South Carolina lawmakers considering permanent ban on SNAP-eligible products
item.description: COLUMBIA, S.C. item.title: Tractor trailer overturned in Pickens County
item.description: PICKENS COUNTY, S.C. (WSPA) - The South Carolina Highway Patrol reported a tractor trailer carrying debris had overturned in Pickens County.
